sourcedFrom: Ruger Precision Rimfire Instruction Manual — PM697 (2026)
cleanIntro: One control does the whole strip on a Precision Rimfire: depress the bolt stop and the bolt slides out.

steps.title: Clear it and drop the magazine
steps.action: Point the rifle in a safe direction, remove the magazine, open the bolt and confirm the chamber is empty.
steps.prose: Magazine first, then chamber, then anything else.
steps.quote: Remove the bolt from the rifle by depressing the bolt stop and sliding the bolt out of the firearm.
steps.cite: Ruger Precision Rimfire Instruction Manual — PM697 — Disassembly, p.16
steps.warn: Rifle must be unloaded prior to disassembly.

steps.title: Bolt out at the bolt stop
steps.action: Depress the bolt stop and slide the bolt out of the rifle.
steps.prose: That is the strip. Nothing else is published for cleaning.
steps.quote: depressing the bolt stop and sliding the bolt out of the firearm.
steps.cite: Ruger Precision Rimfire Instruction Manual — PM697 — Disassembly, p.16

deepAbsentReason: PM697 documents bolt removal as the disassembly. Nothing past it is published, so this listing has NO deep clean.

cleaning.name: BORE & CHAMBER
tasks: Solvent patch, correctly sized brush, then dry patches until clean
Rimfire fouling is waxy and builds fast — the chamber needs as much attention as the bore
Clean from the chamber end where the design allows

cleaning.name: BOLT / ACTION
tasks: Wipe the bolt face and around the extractor
Clean the receiver raceways and the magazine well
Light oil on bearing surfaces only

cleaning.name: MAGAZINES
tasks: Wipe magazine bodies dry — no oil where ammunition sits

reassembly: Depress the bolt stop and insert the bolt into the receiver, closing the bolt handle fully down.
fncheck: With the magazine out and chamber confirmed empty, check the safety blocks the trigger and the bolt closes fully.
